data.name: Query_ForHSMExportSaleRegister_Report
data.value:
Select SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as Dated, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Customer, SET_Currency.CurrencyID, SET_Currency.CurrencyName, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FCAmount as ForeignValue, SAL_InvoiceHeader.ConversionRate as Rate, CASE WHEN (SELECT OperatingUnitName FROM SET_Company INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitID = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status = 1 WHERE CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status = 1) LIKE 'Textiles' THEN isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced,0) * isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice,0) ELSE isnull(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FCAmount,0) * isnull(SAL_InvoiceHeader.ConversionRate,0) END as SaleBooked, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) as LBS, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType
From SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID And [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID And [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID and [SAL_InvoiceDetail].Status = 1 Inner Join [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] And [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] And [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] And [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] And [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 Inner Join [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] And [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] And [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] And [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 Left Join SAL_DispatchHeader ON SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[FiscalID] And SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 -- Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID -- And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 -- Left Join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID -- Left Join [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID -- And [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID And [SAL_OrderDetail].CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID And [SAL_OrderDetail].PeriodID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID And [SAL_OrderDetail].Status = 1 -- Left Join [SAL_ContractDetail] ON [SAL_ContractDetail].ContractDetailID = [SAL_OrderDetail].ContractDetailID -- And [SAL_ContractDetail].ContractID = [SAL_OrderDetail].ContractHeaderID And [SAL_ContractDetail].CompanyID = [SAL_OrderDetail].CompanyID And [SAL_ContractDetail].PeriodID= [SAL_OrderDetail].PeriodID And [SAL_ContractDetail].Status = 1 Inner Join [SET_Currency] ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID = SET_Currency.CurrencyID Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice - Towels (Export)%' --Left Join [SET_Term] ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID = SET_Term.TermID Left Join [AR_SET_Customer] on SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = [AR_SET_Customer].CustomerID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = [AR_SET_Customer].PeriodID -- Inner Join [SAL_OrderHeader] on [SAL_OrderHeader].OrderID= SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID --And [SAL_OrderHeader].CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID And [SAL_OrderHeader].PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And [SAL_OrderHeader].Status=1 -- left Join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = [SAL_ContractDetail].ContractID And SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = [SAL_ContractDetail].CompanyID And SAL_ContractHeader.FiscalID = [SAL_ContractDetail].FiscalID --And SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = [SAL_ContractDetail].PeriodID And SAL_ContractHeader.Status =1 And SAL_ContractHeader.StatusCode = 1 --Left Join INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID And INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And INV_SET_Category.[Status] = 1 --Left Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.[Status] = 1 --Left Join SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID and SET_UnitofMeasure.[Status] = 1 Left Join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate And Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Where SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID= @PeriodID

data.name: Query_GetAllDispatchForSheikhoo
data.value:
Select * from(
Select convert(Varchar(Max),FinTab.DispatchNo) as DispatchNo, Convert(Varchar(Max),FinTab.DispatchID) as DispatchID, FinTab.DispatchDate, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.IsExporter, FinTab.IsRegistered ,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.DocumentType, --Sum(FinTab.TotalAmount) as TotalAmount SUM(ABS(FinTab.Quantity) * FinTab.Rate) as TotalAmount ,SUM(ABS(FinTab.Quantity)) as TotalQuantity ,max(FinTab.UOMName) as UOMName ,max(DeliveryOrderNo) as DeliveryOrderNo ,FinTab.Action ,FinTab.CustomerCNICII ,ContractNo ,WeightOption ,CustomerCategory ,convert(bit,1) as isChecked From ( Select * from ( Select (SELECT Distinct STUFF ( (SELECT ',' + D1.DispatchNo FROM SAL_DispatchHeader as D1 Where D1.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND D1.CustomerCNICII = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII --AND D1.[DispatchDate] Between @DateFrom AND @DateTo And D1.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID And D1.Status=1 AND D1.DispatchDate = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate -- AND D1.BiltyNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo AND D1.CustomerNameII = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII And D1.DispatchNo in (Select DispatchNo from ( Select Tab.Quantity, Tab.DispatchNo, Tab.DocumentTypeID,Tab.CustomerID,Tab.CompanyID, Tab.PeriodID,Tab.FiscalID, Tab.DispatchDate --,Tab.TotalAmount ,SUM(ABS(Tab.Quantity) * Tab.Rate) as TotalAmount ,Tab.CustomerCNICII from ( Select Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) AS Quantity ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo , [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID, [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID, [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].TotalAmount ,SAL_ContractDetail.Rate ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII from SAL_DispatchHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID=SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo=SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID=SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1
Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1
Inner JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status = 1 inner Join [SAL_OrderHeader] on [SAL_OrderHeader].OrderID= SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID --AND [SAL_OrderHeader].FiscalID = SAL_OrderDetail.FiscalID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].Status=1
inner join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_ContractHeader contHdr on contHdr.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and contHdr.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and contHdr.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Status = 1 left join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1
Where [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] =@PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID]= @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[FiscalID]=@FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate] Between @DateFrom AND @DateTo And SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode=1 And SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID
and isnull(INV_SET_Category.SeperateInvoices,0) = 0
and contHdr.ContractID = SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID )Tab Where Tab.Quantity > 0 group by tab.Quantity,tab.DispatchNo,tab.DocumentTypeID,tab.CustomerID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PeriodID,tab.FiscalID,tab.DispatchDate ,tab.Rate,tab.CustomerCNICII )FinTab) And D1.StatusCode=1 FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '' ) as DispatchNo FROM SAL_DispatchHeader Dispatch2 Where Dispatch2.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND Dispatch2.[DispatchDate] = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate ---AND Dispatch2.CustomerCNICII = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII AND Dispatch2.Status=1 GROUP by CustomerID, DispatchDate, DocumentTypeID , CustomerCNICII) as DispatchNo ,(SELECT Distinct STUFF ( (SELECT ',' + Cast(D3.DispatchID as Varchar) FROM SAL_DispatchHeader as D3 Where D3.CustomerID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND D3.CustomerCNICII = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII --AND D3.[DispatchDate] Between @DateFrom AND @DateTo And D3.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID And D3.Status= 1 AND D3.DispatchDate = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate -- AND D3.BiltyNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo AND D3.CustomerNameII = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII And D3.DispatchNo in (Select DispatchNo from ( Select Tab.Quantity, Tab.DispatchNo, Tab.DocumentTypeID,Tab.CustomerID,Tab.CompanyID, Tab.PeriodID,Tab.FiscalID, Tab.DispatchDate --,Tab.TotalAmount ,SUM(ABS(Tab.Quantity) * Tab.Rate) as TotalAmount from ( Select Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) AS Quantity ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo , [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID, [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID, [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].TotalAmount ,SAL_ContractDetail.Rate from SAL_DispatchHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID=SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo=SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID=SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1
Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1
Inner JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status = 1 inner Join [SAL_OrderHeader] on [SAL_OrderHeader].OrderID= SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID --AND [SAL_OrderHeader].FiscalID = SAL_OrderDetail.FiscalID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].Status=1
inner join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_ContractHeader contHdr on contHdr.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and contHdr.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and contHdr.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Status = 1 left join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1
Where [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] =@PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID]= @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[FiscalID]=@FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate] Between @DateFrom AND @DateTo And SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode=1 And SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID
and isnull(INV_SET_Category.SeperateInvoices,0) = 0
and contHdr.ContractID = SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID )Tab Where Tab.Quantity > 0 group by tab.Quantity,tab.DispatchNo,tab.DocumentTypeID,tab.CustomerID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PeriodID,tab.FiscalID,tab.DispatchDate ,tab.Rate )FinTab) And D3.StatusCode=1 FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '' ) as DispatchNo FROM SAL_DispatchHeader Dispatch3 Where Dispatch3.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND Dispatch3.[DispatchDate] = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate GROUP by CustomerID, DispatchDate, DocumentTypeID , CustomerCNICII) as DispatchID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, CostCentreID,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered, SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationName , SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType , SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount ,SAL_ContractDetail.Rate ,'Add' as Action, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) AS Quantity ,SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII , SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo ,SET_Unitofmeasure.UOMName ,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo , case when SAL_ContractHeader.Weightby = 1 then 'Mill Weight' when SAL_ContractHeader.Weightby = 2 then 'Party Weight' else '' end as WeightOption ,Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, convert(bit,1) as isChecked
From SAL_DispatchHeader Left Join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CostCentreID AND SET_CostCenter.Status=1 Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 left join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID and Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID Left Join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID=SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID AND SET_Location.Status=1 Inner Join Set_PeriodCustom on Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID=SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID= SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID=SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo=SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID=SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1
Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1
Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.companyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.companyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID
Inner JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status = 1 inner Join [SAL_OrderHeader] on [SAL_OrderHeader].OrderID= SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID --AND [SAL_OrderHeader].FiscalID = SAL_OrderDetail.FiscalID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].Status=1
inner join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Status = 1 left join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1
left join SET_Unitofmeasure on SET_Unitofmeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID]= @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[FiscalID]= @FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate] Between @DateFrom AND @DateTo And SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode=1 And SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID
and isnull(INV_SET_Category.SeperateInvoices,0) = 0 )Tab Where Tab.Quantity>0 And Tab.DispatchNo is not null )FinTab Group By FinTab.DispatchNo, FinTab.DispatchID, FinTab.DispatchDate, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.IsExporter, FinTab.IsRegistered, FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.Action ,FinTab.CustomerCNICII,ContractNo ,FinTab.WeightOption ,FinTab.CustomerCategory
Union ALL
Select convert(Varchar(Max),FinTab.DispatchNo) as DispatchNo, Convert(Varchar(Max),FinTab.DispatchID) as DispatchID, FinTab.DispatchDate, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.IsExporter, FinTab.IsRegistered ,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.DocumentType, --Sum(FinTab.TotalAmount) as TotalAmount SUM(ABS(FinTab.Quantity) * FinTab.Rate) as TotalAmount ,SUM(ABS(FinTab.Quantity)) as TotalQuantity ,max(FinTab.UOMName) as UOMName ,max(DeliveryOrderNo) as DeliveryOrderNo ,FinTab.Action ,FinTab.CustomerCNICII ,ContractNo ,WeightOption ,CustomerCategory, convert(bit,1) as isChecked From ( Select * from ( Select DispatchNo , DispatchID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, CostCentreID,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered, SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationName , SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType , SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount ,SAL_ContractDetail.Rate ,'Add' as Action, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = end) as BuyerAddress ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoNo ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoDate ,AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber ,AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName ,SET_City.CityName ,SET_Area.AreaName ,AR_SET_Bank.BankName ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchComments FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID =INV_Item.CompanyID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID and Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left JOin SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID And SET_UnitofMeasure.status=1 left join Set_Batch on Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_ContractHeader.Season
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BankAccount ON AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_SET_Customer.FK_BankAccountID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BankBranch ON AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_SET_BankBranch.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN SET_City ON SET_City.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID LEFT JOIN SET_Area ON SET_Area.AreaID = AR_SET_Customer.AreaID
left join ar_set_Customer CustomerParty on CustomerParty.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerPartyID --and ar_set_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and CustomerParty.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Bank ON AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID AND AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1
WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+ substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as SINumber
,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding AS WithHolding ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount AS NetAmount --,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo AS ContractNo ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end as ContractNo --,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate AS ContractDate, ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as ContractDate, ( case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) else ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate,0) ) end
) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_ContractHeader.BGMaturityDate, SAL_ContractHeader.BGNo, --([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + -- (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 -- else -- 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount As TAmountReceivable, SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as BrokerName ,SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 as UnitAddress, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber as UnitPhoneNo, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber as UnitFaxNo ,Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory as BrokerCategory ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID --and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount
, (select distinct stuff(( select distinct ',' + COnvert(varchar(10),u.AdvancePaymentID) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment u where u.AdvancePaymentID = AdvancePaymentID and u.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID
for xml path('') ),1,1,'') as userlist from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID group by AdvancePaymentID) as PaymentReference
,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance
,SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo ,upper(substring(AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,0,5)) as CustomerPrefix ,SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoiceNo ,SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoicedate ,isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG) as Rate ,Set_Batch.Description as CropYear ,(case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 else AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 end) as BuyerAddress ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoNo ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoDate ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchComments ,isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].FEDFixRate,0) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced as FixFEDAmount ,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceResponse.InvoiceNumber,'') AS FBR_InvoiceNumber ,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceResponse.QRimageURL,'') AS QRimageURL
FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] LEFT join SAL_InvoiceResponse on SAL_InvoiceResponse.SalesInvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceResponse.InvoiceCompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceResponse.Status = 'Valid' INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID and [SAL_InvoiceDetail].status = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID
left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID
left join ar_set_Customer CustomerParty on CustomerParty.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerPartyID and CustomerParty.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID and Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left JOin SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID And SET_UnitofMeasure.status=1 left join Set_Batch on Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_ContractHeader.Season WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

SELECT Distinct ceiling(NetWeight)/ INV_Item.UnitVolume as Bags, [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].Description ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo as DeliveryOrderNo,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPO,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPODate --,Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced as Quantity , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyActualAmount --, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount
--,CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01' -- AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then 70.2 else 70.3404 end -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- and ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0) = '0' -- ) -- THEN -- ( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight -- * ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) -- + ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 -- ) THEN 3.60 -- ELSE 0 -- END ) ) )) ) -- - ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight -- * ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) -- + ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 -- ) THEN 3.60 -- ELSE 0 -- END ) ) ) ) -- * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) -- / ( 100 -- + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) ) -- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100 -- + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ) -- ELSE -- ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate -- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 ) -- END -- as SaleTaxAmount
,
SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount
*
(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate AND ISNULL(SET_SalesTaxParameters.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID) = 1 then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount/ 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) end)
end) else --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount] + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) ) -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) / (100+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) )
( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] - (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) )
-- / (100+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) )
end )
/ (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + isnull(Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.FurtherTax,0))
as SaleTaxAmount
,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate AND ISNULL(SET_SalesTaxParameters.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID) = 1 then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount/ 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) end)
end) else --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount] + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) ) (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) / (100+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) ) end ) as SaleTaxAmountNew
, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount --, (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) * --( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ,INV_Item.UnitWeight ,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG , SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SalesTaxPer --,SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as FEDTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding as WithHoldingTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyAmountTaxPer ,[SAL_OrderHeader].DTRENo , [SAL_OrderHeader].DTREDate --,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight) * [SAL_OrderDetail].PriceperKG) As AmountReceivable , case when SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else --SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG (sal_invoicedetail.unitprice / INV_Item.UnitWeight ) end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end )))
else
(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else --SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG (sal_invoicedetail.unitprice / INV_Item.UnitWeight ) end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end ))) + (
(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else --SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG (sal_invoicedetail.unitprice / INV_Item.UnitWeight ) end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end ))) * (isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount,0) + isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].ExciseDutyAmount,0)) / 100 )
end As AmountReceivable ,SET_Business.BusinessName as SupplierName ,SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as SupplierNameComplete ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 as SupplierAddress ,SET_Business.NTNNumber as SupplierNTN, SET_Business.PhoneNumber as SupplierPhoneNumber , SET_Business.SalesTaxNumber as SupplierSTRN, [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid, BC.CustomerName as BIllTo, --AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,
--[SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII as CustomerName case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then isnull(CustomerParty.CustomerName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName) else isnull(CustomerParty.CustomerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverName) end as CustomerName
--case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) = 1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 --then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName --else (SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverName) end as CustomerName

) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_ContractHeader.BGMaturityDate, SAL_ContractHeader.BGNo, --([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + -- (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 -- else -- 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount As TAmountReceivable, SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as BrokerName ,SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 as UnitAddress, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber as UnitPhoneNo, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber as UnitFaxNo ,Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory as BrokerCategory ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)AdvanceAmount

,SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo ,upper(substring(AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,0,5)) as CustomerPrefix ,SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoiceNo ,SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoicedate ,isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG) as Rate ,Set_Batch.Description as CropYear ,(case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 else AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 end) as BuyerAddress ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoNo ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoDate ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchComments ,isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].FEDFixRate,0) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced as FixFEDAmount FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID and [SAL_InvoiceDetail].status = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID
left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID
left join ar_set_Customer CustomerParty on CustomerParty.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerPartyID and CustomerParty.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID and Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left JOin SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID And SET_UnitofMeasure.status=1 left join Set_Batch on Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_ContractHeader.Season WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

SELECT Distinct ceiling(NetWeight)/ INV_Item.UnitVolume as Bags, [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].Description ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo as DeliveryOrderNo,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPO,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerCallPODate --,Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced as Quantity , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyActualAmount --, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount
--,CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01' -- AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then 70.2 else 70.3404 end -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- and ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0) = '0' -- ) -- THEN -- ( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight -- * ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) -- + ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 -- ) THEN 3.60 -- ELSE 0 -- END ) ) )) ) -- - ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight -- * ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) -- + ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 -- ) THEN 3.60 -- ELSE 0 -- END ) ) ) ) -- * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) -- / ( 100 -- + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) ) -- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100 -- + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ) -- ELSE -- ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate -- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 ) -- END -- as SaleTaxAmount
, CASE WHEN ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 0 THEN ( (case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No dbo.GetBiggerValue(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate ,(select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc )) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount/ 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0)= isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) end)
end) ) ELSE (
SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount *
(case when ( SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate AND ISNULL(SET_SalesTaxParameters.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID desc) = 1 then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) ORDER by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount/ 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0)= isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) end)
end) else --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount] + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) ) -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) / (100+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) )
( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] - (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) )
-- / (100+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) )
end )
/ (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + isnull(Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.FurtherTax,0)) ) end
as SaleTaxAmount
,(case when ( SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate AND ISNULL(SET_SalesTaxParameters.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID desc) = 1 then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0)= isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount/ 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) end)
end) else --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount] + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) ) (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) / (100+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) ) end ) as SaleTaxAmountNew

else
(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else --SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG (sal_invoicedetail.unitprice / INV_Item.UnitWeight ) end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end ))) + (

end As AmountReceivable ,SET_Business.BusinessName as SupplierName ,SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as SupplierNameComplete ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 as SupplierAddress ,SET_Business.NTNNumber as SupplierNTN, SET_Business.PhoneNumber as SupplierPhoneNumber , SET_Business.SalesTaxNumber as SupplierSTRN, [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid, BC.CustomerName as BIllTo, --AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,

) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_ContractHeader.BGMaturityDate, SAL_ContractHeader.BGNo, --([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + -- (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 -- else -- 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount As TAmountReceivable, SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as BrokerName ,SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 as UnitAddress, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber as UnitPhoneNo, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber as UnitFaxNo ,Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory as BrokerCategory ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)AdvanceAmount
