SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII end as BuyerName, CustomerParty.CustomerName as CustomerPartyName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, --Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, (case when Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory like '%exempt%' then 'EXEMPTED' else (case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end) end) as CustomerCategory, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, --Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, --'SI' +'-'+ Case When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' Then 'S' else '' end as DocumentType, 'SI' as DocumentType,
(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1) +'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+ substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, --'1701B - Cane Sugar' as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) ) as FixedSalesTaxAmount
,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID) = 1 then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount] + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) ) end ) as SaleTaxAmount ,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)) as ValueSaleReturn , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as FurtherTaxAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount,
--case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 -- then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive -- else -- --[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + --(Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then 3.60 -- else -- 0 end))))) -- end as AmountReceivable
case when SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive = 1 then
(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end )))
else
((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end ))) +
(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end ))) * (isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount,0) + isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].ExciseDutyAmount,0)) / 100)
end As AmountReceivable
,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax
,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance

and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)FurtherTaxAdvance,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo , ,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=

(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount] + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) ) end ) as SaleTaxAmount ,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)) as ValueSaleReturn , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as FurtherTaxAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount,
--case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 -- then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive -- else -- --[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + --(Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then 3.60 -- else -- 0 end))))) -- end as AmountReceivable

and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)FurtherTaxAdvance,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo , , AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName , '' as InvoiceType, 'APR' as DocumentType, convert(varchar,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentNo) as InvoiceNumber,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.RecievingDate as DocumentDate,'' as SaleType, '' as Rate, 0 as ItemID ,'' as ItemName , AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Quantity,'' as UOMName, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.WithHoldingTax as WithHolding, 0 as TaxAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyAmount,0 as FEDAmount,0 as FixedSalesTaxAmount, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.FEDAmount as SaleTaxAmount, 0 as ValueSaleReturn, 0 as FurtherTaxAmount, 0 as FEDTaxAmount, 0 as WithHoldingAmount, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.AdvanceAmount as AmountReceivable, 0 as ActualInvoiceAmount, '' as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode ,CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone,null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax ,0 as AdvanceAmount, 0 as FurtherTaxAdvance ,2 as Adjusted ,0 as RateExcludingSaleTax from AP_AdvanceSugarPayment Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1

--case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' --else (Case When -- AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else --'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory
(case when Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory like '%exempt%' then 'EXEMPTED' else (case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end) end) as CustomerCategory
, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName , '' as InvoiceType, 'APR' as DocumentType, convert(varchar,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentNo) as InvoiceNumber,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.RecievingDate as DocumentDate,'' as SaleType, '' as Rate, 0 as ItemID ,'' as ItemName , AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Quantity,'' as UOMName, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.WithHoldingTax as WithHolding, 0 as TaxAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyAmount,0 as FEDAmount,0 as FixedSalesTaxAmount, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.FEDAmount as SaleTaxAmount, 0 as ValueSaleReturn, 0 as FurtherTaxAmount, 0 as FEDTaxAmount, 0 as WithHoldingAmount, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.AdvanceAmount as AmountReceivable, 0 as ActualInvoiceAmount, '' as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode ,CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone,null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax ,0 as AdvanceAmount, 0 as FurtherTaxAdvance ,2 as Adjusted ,0 as RateExcludingSaleTax from AP_AdvanceSugarPayment Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID -- AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1
Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID where AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Status = 1 and RecievingDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID And (AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null)

case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory,
--(case when Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory like '%exempt%' then 'EXEMPTED' else (case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' --else (Case When -- AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else --'UNREGISTERED' end) end) end) as CustomerCategory
AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName , '' as InvoiceType, 'APR' as DocumentType, convert(varchar,SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo) as InvoiceNumber ,SAL_ReverseDetail.CreateDate as DocumentDate,'' as SaleType, '' as Rate, 0 as ItemID ,'' as ItemName , SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedQuantity * -1 as Quantity,'' as UOMName, 0 as WithHolding, 0 as TaxAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyAmount,0 as FEDAmount,0 as FixedSalesTaxAmount, 0 as SaleTaxAmount, 0 as ValueSaleReturn, 0 as FurtherTaxAmount, 0 as FEDTaxAmount, 0 as WithHoldingAmount, 0 as AmountReceivable, 0 as ActualInvoiceAmount, '' as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode ,CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone,null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax ,0 as AdvanceAmount, 0 as FurtherTaxAdvance ,1 as Adjusted ,0 as RateExcludingSaleTax from SAL_ReverseHeader Inner Join SAL_ReverseDetail on SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID = SAL_ReverseDetail.ReverseHeaderID And SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID And SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID ANd SAL_ReverseDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join SAL_InvoiceHeader on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID -- AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1
Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID where SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_ReverseHeader.Status = 1 {1} --And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) And (SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null) {0}

,(tab.CustomerCategory),(tab.Provinceid),(tab.ProvinceName),(tab.InvoiceType), (tab.DocumentType), (tab.InvoiceNumber),tab.DocumentDate,tab.SaleType,tab.Rate,tab.ItemID,tab.ItemName, sum(tab.Quantity) AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII end as BuyerName, CustomerParty.CustomerName as CustomerPartyName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, --Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, (case when Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory like '%exempt%' then 'EXEMPTED' else (case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end) end) as CustomerCategory, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, --Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, --'SI' +'-'+ Case When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' Then 'S' else '' end as DocumentType, 'SI' as DocumentType,
(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1) +'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+ substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, --'1701B - Cane Sugar' as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) ) as FixedSalesTaxAmount
,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID) = 1 then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) end)
end) else (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount)) end ) as SaleTaxAmount ,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)) as ValueSaleReturn , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as FurtherTaxAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount,
--case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 -- then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive -- else -- --[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + --(Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then 3.60 -- else -- 0 end))))) -- end as AmountReceivable
(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate else (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate - (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 34 No
(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else --SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG (sal_invoicedetail.unitprice / INV_Item.UnitWeight ) end )) end )) )
--([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) --+ --(SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced)
else ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) + (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else
case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * ((sal_invoicedetail.unitprice / INV_Item.UnitWeight))) -----([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity + (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end end ) as AmountReceivable
,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax
,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)FurtherTaxAdvance,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo , SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as RateExcludingSaleTax ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID from SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner Join SAL_DispatchHeader on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount * (case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <= (case when (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate AND ISNULL(SET_SalesTaxParameters.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID) = 1 then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ))) end ) ) then (case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount/ 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) end) end) else ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] - (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) )
end ) / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + isnull(Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.FurtherTax,0)) as SaleTaxAmount
,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate AND ISNULL(SET_SalesTaxParameters.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID) = 1 then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount/ 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) end)
end) else (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) / (100+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) ) end ) as SaleTaxAmountNew
, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ,INV_Item.UnitWeight ,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG , SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SalesTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as FEDTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding as WithHoldingTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyAmountTaxPer ,[SAL_OrderHeader].DTRENo , [SAL_OrderHeader].DTREDate , case when SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else (sal_invoicedetail.unitprice / INV_Item.UnitWeight ) end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end )))
else
(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else (sal_invoicedetail.unitprice / INV_Item.UnitWeight ) end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end ))) + (
(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else (sal_invoicedetail.unitprice / INV_Item.UnitWeight ) end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end ))) * (isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount,0) + isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].ExciseDutyAmount,0)) / 100 )
end As AmountReceivable ,SET_Business.BusinessName as SupplierName ,SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as SupplierNameComplete ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 as SupplierAddress ,SET_Business.NTNNumber as SupplierNTN, SET_Business.PhoneNumber as SupplierPhoneNumber , SET_Business.SalesTaxNumber as SupplierSTRN, [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid, BC.CustomerName as BIllTo, case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then isnull(CustomerParty.CustomerName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName) else isnull(CustomerParty.CustomerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverName) end as CustomerName
--,case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 --then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 --else CustomerParty.AddressLine1 end as CustomerAddress,
,CustomerParty.AddressLine1 as CustomerAddress,
--case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) = 1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber else CustomerParty.NTNNumber end as CustomerNTN, CustomerParty.NTNNumber as CustomerNTN, case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) = 1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber else CustomerParty.PhoneNumber end as CustomerPhoneNumber --,case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) = 1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber else CustomerParty.STRNNumber end as CustomeSTRN
,CustomerParty.STRNNumber as CustomeSTRN --,case when --isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 --then AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber --else --(case when isnull((select FieldValue1 from Set_Parameter where FieldName = 'IsRaniPurSugarMill'),'') = 'True' -- then CustomerParty.CNICNumber -- else [SAL_DispatchHeader].DriverCNIC -- end -- ) --end as CNICNumber,
,CustomerParty.CNICNumber as CNICNumber,
[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo as DispatchNo, INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemStatusCode, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) AS [BaseQuantity] ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Transactioncost as UnitPrice, [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount, [SAL_OrderDetail].[T_GrossAmount], ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0) as TotalAmount ,SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage as LogoImage ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerAddress as Shipto,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].Description as DescriptionTagNo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken ,(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1) +'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+ substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as SINumber
,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding AS WithHolding ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount AS NetAmount ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end as ContractNo ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as ContractDate, ( case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) else ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate,0) ) end
) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_ContractHeader.BGMaturityDate, SAL_ContractHeader.BGNo, SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount As TAmountReceivable, SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as BrokerName ,SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 as UnitAddress, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber as UnitPhoneNo, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber as UnitFaxNo ,Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory as BrokerCategory ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID ),0)AdvanceAmount
, (select distinct stuff(( select distinct ',' + COnvert(varchar(10),u.AdvancePaymentID) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment u where u.AdvancePaymentID = AdvancePaymentID and u.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID
for xml path('') ),1,1,'') as userlist from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID group by AdvancePaymentID) as PaymentReference
,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance
,SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo ,upper(substring(AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,0,5)) as CustomerPrefix ,SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoiceNo ,SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoicedate ,isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG) as Rate ,Set_Batch.Description as CropYear ,(case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 else AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 end) as BuyerAddress ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoNo ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoDate ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchComments ,isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].FEDFixRate,0) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced as FixFEDAmount ,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceResponse.InvoiceNumber,'') AS FBR_InvoiceNumber ,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceResponse.QRimageURL,'') AS QRimageURL
FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] LEFT join SAL_InvoiceResponse on SAL_InvoiceResponse.SalesInvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceResponse.InvoiceCompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceResponse.Status = 'Valid' INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID and [SAL_InvoiceDetail].status = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID
left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID
left join ar_set_Customer CustomerParty on CustomerParty.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerPartyID and CustomerParty.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID and Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID left JOin SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID And SET_UnitofMeasure.status=1 left join Set_Batch on Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_ContractHeader.Season WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

data.name: Query_SelectSeperateDispatch
data.value:
--DECLARE @CompanyID INT = 1, --@PeriodID INT = 1, --@FiscalID INT = 4, --@DateFrom date = '2024-10-01', --@DateTo date = '2024-10-30', --@DocumentTypeID int = 19;
Select * from( Select FinTab.DispatchNo, FinTab.DispatchID, FinTab.DispatchDate, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.IsExporter, FinTab.IsRegistered ,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.DocumentType, Sum(FinTab.TotalAmount) as TotalAmount ,FinTab.Action ,FinTab.CustomerCNICII,CustomerProvinceID ,case when CustomerProvinceID = 1 then 'Balochistan' when CustomerProvinceID = 2 then 'KPK' when CustomerProvinceID = 3 then 'Punjab' when CustomerProvinceID = 4 then 'Sindh'end as ProvinceName From ( Select * from ( Select DispatchNo , DispatchID ,DispatchDate, CostCentreID,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, ISNULL(CustomerParty.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID) AS CustomerID, ISNULL(CustomerParty.CustomerName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName) AS CustomerName, CASE WHEN CustomerParty.CustomerID IS NOT NULL THEN CustomerParty.IsExporter ELSE AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter END AS IsExporter, CASE WHEN CustomerParty.CustomerID IS NOT NULL THEN CustomerParty.IsRegistered ELSE AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered END AS IsRegistered, SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationName , SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType , SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount ,'Add' as Action, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) AS Quantity ,SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII,CustomerProvinceID From SAL_DispatchHeader Left Join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CostCentreID AND SET_CostCenter.Status=1 Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID --AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer CustomerParty ON CustomerParty.CustomerID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerPartyID
Left Join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID=SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID AND SET_Location.Status=1 Inner Join Set_PeriodCustom on Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID=SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID= SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID=SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo=SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID=SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID]= @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[FiscalID]= @FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate] Between @DateFrom AND @DateTo And SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode=1 And SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID and SAL_DispatchHeader.ReturnID is null )Tab
Where Tab.Quantity>0 And Tab.DispatchNo is not null
Group By Tab.DispatchNo, Tab.DispatchID, Tab.DispatchDate,Tab.CustomerID, Tab.CustomerName, Tab.IsExporter, Tab.IsRegistered, Tab.DocumentTypeID, Tab.DocumentType,Tab.Action,CustomerProvinceID, Tab.CostCentreID, Tab.CostCenterName, Tab.LocationID, Tab.LocationName, Tab.TotalAmount, Tab.Quantity, Tab.CustomerCNICII

ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) AS Quantity ,CustomerProvinceID From SAL_DispatchHeader Left Join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CostCentreID AND SET_CostCenter.Status=1 Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID --AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1)
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer CustomerParty ON CustomerParty.CustomerID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerPartyID
Left Join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID=SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID AND SET_Location.Status=1 Inner Join Set_PeriodCustom on Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID=SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID= SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID=SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo=SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID=SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] =@PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID]= @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[FiscalID]=@FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate] Between @DateFrom AND @DateTo And SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode=1 And SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID and SAL_DispatchHeader.ReturnID is null --AND (Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory not like '%Manufacturer%' or Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory not like '%Exporter%') )Tab
Where Tab.Quantity>0
Group By Tab.DispatchNo, Tab.DispatchID, Tab.DispatchDate,Tab.CustomerID, Tab.CustomerName, Tab.IsExporter, Tab.IsRegistered, Tab.DocumentTypeID, Tab.DocumentType,Tab.Action,CustomerProvinceID, Tab.CostCentreID, Tab.CostCenterName, Tab.LocationID, Tab.LocationName, Tab.TotalAmount, Tab.Quantity

) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_ContractHeader.BGMaturityDate, SAL_ContractHeader.BGNo, --([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + -- (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 -- else -- 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount As TAmountReceivable, SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as BrokerName ,SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 as UnitAddress, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber as UnitPhoneNo, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber as UnitFaxNo ,Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory as BrokerCategory ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID --and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount

,SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo ,upper(substring(AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,0,5)) as CustomerPrefix ,SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoiceNo ,SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoicedate ,isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG) as Rate ,Set_Batch.Description as CropYear ,(case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 else AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 end) as BuyerAddress ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoNo ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoDate ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchComments ,isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].FEDFixRate,0) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced as FixFEDAmount ,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceResponse.InvoiceNumber,'') AS FBR_InvoiceNumber ,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceResponse.QRimageURL,'') AS QRimageURL
FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] LEFT join SAL_InvoiceResponse on SAL_InvoiceResponse.SalesInvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceResponse.InvoiceCompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceResponse.Status = 'Valid' INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID and [SAL_InvoiceDetail].status = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID
left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID
left join ar_set_Customer CustomerParty on CustomerParty.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerPartyID and CustomerParty.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID and Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left JOin SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID And SET_UnitofMeasure.status=1 left join Set_Batch on Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_ContractHeader.Season WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount/ 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) end)
end) else --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount] + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) ) (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) / (100+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) ) end ) as SaleTaxAmountNew

else

) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_ContractHeader.BGMaturityDate, SAL_ContractHeader.BGNo, --([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + -- (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 -- else -- 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount As TAmountReceivable, SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as BrokerName ,SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 as UnitAddress, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber as UnitPhoneNo, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber as UnitFaxNo ,Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory as BrokerCategory ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID --and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount
